programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl. This battle won't be s

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers travel by helicopter to their re-match against the Psykick's. During the flight, Hilary remembers how Psykick trapped her and Kenny on a cargo ship; Max ponders their recent training; Kai regrets the Psykick' mistreatment of Wyatt;; Ray recalls the time Salima reached out to him; and Tyson remains bitter about Kane joining Psykick. When they arrive at the battle location - a five-story, monolithic building called 'The Battle Tower' - they're greeted by Gideon via video screen, who outlines the format. On each floor, one Psykick awaits a different Blade Breaker, and each match will be a one-match-only sudden death battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Max Takes One For The Team
programme.desc: The first battle between Team Psykick and the Bladebreakers has begun! Max fights bravely against Jim and Cyber Draciel' and his teammates aren't the only ones interested in the outcome of the battle. Dr. B and Gideon watch from the sidelines, and the Saint Sheilds are there to watch their backs. Max defeats Jim, but amazingly, Cyber Draciel is repaired!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: The Bigger The Cyber-Driger, The Harder It Falls
programme.desc: A confused and heartbroken Ray must face Salima in a dangerous challenge of Drigers! Despite the threat of losing his bit-beast forever, Ray hesitates' baffled by the extreme change in Salima's personality. It wasn't long ago that she confided in Ray and told him of the troubling bit-beast experiments being conducted by the Psykick's' and now' it looks like she's in the same boat as Goki and Jim! Mind-Controlled by their own cyber-bit-beasts! But Ray can't stand back for long' not after realizing his team is depending on him' and even in the face of team Psykick's blatant cheating' Ray refuses to back down' he's not just fighting for a win' he's fighting to bring back the Salima he once knew!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Thanks to Ray's spectacular victory over Salima, the Bladebreakers reach the fourth level of Gideon's Battle Tower and meet their next opponent, Goki of the Psykick's. As Kai steps forward to meet the challenge Gideon and Doctor B prepare several surprises for the team. Using the information gathered from the previous two Beybattles, Doctor B has programmed Driger and Draciel's attack patterns into Goki's Beyblade. Meanwhile, the Saint Shields continue to explore the Psykick's headquarters in an attempt to find Max's captured Draciel.

programme.title: Sonic Underground
programme.desc: Sonic, Manic and Sonia find an abandoned baby in an alley and begin a search for the baby's parents.

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: "ATA 213: Cleveland Preview, Bracket Breakdowns, and Hot Take Scale Predictions - The road to Cleveland is set, and Around the ACL is breaking down everything you need to know before bags fly. Meesh, Jake, and Anthony dive into the Pro Singles brackets, analyzing each path to the final and where the biggest challenges—and opportunities—sit. - Then it’s on to Doubles, where the competition is stacked and the margins are razor thin. Which teams are positioned for a deep run? And where could we see an early shake-up? - To close the show, we turn up the heat with Hot Take Scale—predicting what’s coming next in the season. How likely is it that Logan Chamberlain grabs a Singles title soon? Will Sammy Soto break through with a finals appearance? Could a non–Top 10 team steal the next major—or a player outside the Top 20 take Singles? - Brackets, bold predictions, and plenty of debate—this one sets the stage for Cleveland."

As they experience beautiful scenery, bonds will be formed across cultural divides and relationships will be tested as never before.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S03 E03 - Episode 3 NB
programme.desc: ‘Race Across the World’ is back, as five teams attempt to race sixteen thousand kilometres through the second largest country in the world – Canada. Without smartphones, internet access and credit cards, and armed only with the cash equivalent of the airfare to fly the route, our teams travel this extraordinary journey at ground level. Their skill, ingenuity and determination will be tested to the extreme as they race through some of the world’s most remote regions, where they must also rely on the kindness of strangers in order to stand the best chance of reaching the finish line. This series takes viewers on the trip of a lifetime, following our racers as they embark on an epic and adrenaline-fueled adventure, traveling into the unknown without the trappings of modern life.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E05 - Papua New Guinea - Fire And Water
programme.desc: One of the most fascinating places on earth, and one of the most dangerous, Papua New Guinea is a rough and mostly unexplored country. The guys meet up with their friend Nick on the island of East New Britain, where they visit the lava-buried city of Rabaul, and climb up, and into, an active volcano. Next they explore the island and local dive sites for abandoned World War II relics. Making their way through some thick jungle, they spend a night in a remote family village on their way to a spectacular fire-dancing tribe.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E06 - Papua New Guinea - Without A Paddle
programme.desc: Leaving the islands, the guys head into mainland PNG and drive up into the rugged Highlands with their friend Nick. They travel through Goroka, where they take part in an embarrassing Mudmen dance ritual involving bows, arrows and loincloths. They prepare for an epic journey: A private flight north to a remote grass airstrip, where they have three days to make their way down the extremely remote Sepik River and try to become true men of the Sepik.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys’ adventure begins by zip lining across jungle canopy, rappelling down waterfalls and bungee jumping off a city bridge. They dive with sharks off the Galapagos Islands, and realize the human impact on animals there. On the mainland, they stumble upon the Intiraymi festival, where celebrations are contrasted by near-riots between conflicting tribes. Next, they venture into the Amazon to find the Hourani tribe, and arrive the day of the Chief’s father’s funeral. Attending the ceremony, they learn how the tribes are fighting to keep their traditions alive and protect their land.

Leaving the 21st century behind, he immerses himself in the life of a local meat-loving tribe in Nagaland, once better known for head-hunting than their curries. Then he’s off to Assam to enter a housewives’ competition to find the best Assamese dish; and finally he sets up shop among the street food stalls of Calcutta to try and tempt the local foodies into buying north-east curry – Ramsay style.

programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S03 E01 - Outback Deserts
programme.desc: Australia’s vast interior is dry: nearly a fifth is classified as desert. With little rainfall and temperatures soaring above 50 degrees Celsius, it’s an unrelenting habitat. But these arid areas are also surprisingly varied, and can be breathtakingly spectacular.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.desc: Some of the world’s most ancient and ecologically diverse rainforests are in Australia: from the oldest tropical rainforest on earth, North Queensland’s Daintree, to the stunning central highlands of Tasmania in the far south.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.desc: Australia’s semi-coastal interior is vastly referred to as ‘the bush’. These forested tracts are lush and varied, coloured by extraordinary landscapes and wildlife found nowhere else on the planet.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E11 - Harvesting Health
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E09 - Joshua Tree NB
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within

We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo se disculpa con Irene por haberla besado, Irene le dice que se olvide de lo sucedido. Julio lleva de paseo a Maria Lucia, al final del paseo se dan un beso pero los descubre Trinidad, quien se pone como loca y le pega a Maria Lucia. Luego la encierra en su casa prohibiéndole volver a ver a ese chico. Carlos va a visitar a Virginia a la cárcel para mantener una charla respecto a Irene y su objetivo en la empresa Ferrándiz. Maribel termina confesándole a Alejandra en donde se encontraba Leonardo. Alejandra furiosa pide al helicóptero de la empresa que la lleven hasta el lugar donde Leonardo se encontraba. Juan Pablo le pide a Maribel que lo acompañe a un evento, ella acepta pero no se dio cuenta que esa misma noche tenía la cena con Tony.

programme.title: Episodio 97: Salvador: Pr ncipe Azul y el Secuestro.
programme.desc: Salvador salva a la Princesa Caroline de ser secuestrada. Ella est muy agradecida con Salvador y le dice que es un pr ncipe azul.Josefina le dice a Fernando que si el Latin Lovers da dividendos quiere entrar de nuevo al negocio. Sin embargo le advierte a Fernando que si es novio de Clara no puede hacer parte de Latin Lovers.Lula le da una cachetada a Ramiro por el beso que le dio, le dice que no quiere ser la segunda. - Socorro est muy celosa porque Salvador rescat a la Princesa Caroline.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 97: El Testamento, la Verdad y la Maldad
programme.desc: Aurora le dice a Gabriel que su tío Braulio tiene el testamento de Laura. Marisela y Tomás se conocen en la clínica. Gabriel es atracada por Mandinga y Daniel la defiende. Gabriel conversa con el padre Juan acerca del testamento. Alfonso no es bien recibido por Flavia pro él va a conversar con Isadora de su divorcio con Gabriel. Isadora es descubierta por Alfonso tratando de acomodar el cuadro de Laura que le cayó encima al tramar su maldad en contra de Marisela. Reynaldo interroga a Jenniffer sobre su supuesta violación. Cuando Gavilán le cuenta a Ricardo que vio a Gabriela con Giancarlos, ella llega a la casa. Abril busca a Marisela en la clínica.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 140: Infidelidad, celos y secretos familiares.
programme.desc: Aureliano llega muy entusiasmado y alegre a la bodega y grita lo feliz que se siente porque salio con Felicita. Gabito le pide discreción pero Aureliano no le hace caso y al cabo rato sale Dileidi que lo estaba escuchando todo. Aureliano se sorprende y no sabe que decir, pero Dileidi le dice que el cuento estaba muy bueno y que lo siga contando porque ella se va de la bodega a su casa. Dileidi cuando llega a la casa le cuenta a Gladis lo sucedido, Gerson opina y además de eso dice que Santiago es gay. Gladis que está allí se molesta y discute con Gerson sobre lo que es la responsabilidad de un hombre. Matilde se dispone a dormir en el sofá. Gonzalo le pide explicación de por qué sigue haciendo eso y ella le responde. Gonzalo no lo entiende y se burla de ella. Por la mañana Ernesto no quiere desayunar y Matilde se preocupa, este le dice que es porque su padre no lo ha llamado en quince días. Cuando Gonzalo llega al estacionamiento de su trabajo se encuentra con Yenilú que le dice que lo estaba esperando para darle un chocolate. Allí se dicen cosas y Gonzalo la besa y siguen con una actitud amorosa. Por otro lado, Pascuita esta en la sala de su casa y Monchito le hace preguntas acerca de lo que paso la noche anterior, pero Pascuita actúa como que si no hubiese pasado nada y Monchito se queda muy sorprendido de esa actitud. Matilde llega también al estacionamiento del trabajo y cuando va camino a la oficina ve a Gonzalo y a Yenilú pero no se da cuenta de lo que está pasando. Conversa con Gonzalo como que si no estuviese pasando nada. Yenilú al llegar al trabajo le cuenta todo a Dileidi y esta no lo puede creer y le recuerda que Gonzalo es un hombre casado pero a Yenilú no le importa. Felicita se encuentra en consulta con Edén y le cuenta lo bien que se sintió saliendo con Aureliano. En la oficina Aureliano se dio cuenta que Dileidi lo miro con malos ojos y lo está pensando en el comedor de la empresa, en eso llega Dileidi y lo felicita por la salida que tuvo con Felicita y lo bien que le fue. Aureliano se da cuenta que Dileidi lo que esta es celosa y se lo hace saber, pero Dileidi en todo momento lo niega y se marcha, pero Aureliano no se lo cree. Mientras tanto, en la luna de miel, María Gracia se siente muy mal y no se quiere levantar de la cama. Luís Fernando no le queda otro remedio que quedarse con ella cuidándola. La Nena va camino a casa junto a Tatianita. La Nena le pregunta que por qué es tanta felicidad y Tatianita le cuenta que es porque su papá le contó que la va a reconquistar y otras cosas más. La Nena duda de esa conversación y piensa que los documentos son otra trampa de Aristigueta. Al llegar al destino se encuentra con Aristigueta y Gerson y la dirigen para que se estaciones. La Nena se estaciona pero sale furíca de su carro y les forma un lió porque ellos piensa que ella no sabe manejar y que es una bruta. Gladis que está viendo todo desde la casa de Pascuita observa como Aristigueta y su hijo se dan la mano en son de amistad. Gladis se molesta mucho y cuando se dispone a bajar se encuentra con Pascuita y la ve en un mal estado y muy deprimida. Pascuita le cuenta que por primera vez en su vida se siente muy mal y que piensa que su familia no le agradece todo los esfuerzos que hace por su familia. Gladis la trata de aconsejar. Monchito en la oficina hace el comentario de lo que hizo Pascuita la noche anterior y tanto Gonzalo como Rómulo están de acuerdo con qué a las mujeres no se le entiende nada. Monchito se va a su puesto de trabajo y Gonzalo aprovecha de contarle a Rómulo lo del beso con Yenilú. Rómulo no lo puede creer y cuando le sigue contando llega Matilde y se quedan callados. Matilde pregunta que pasó pero ellos le dan ciertas explicaciones que no convencen a Matilde. Igual situación le pasa a Matilde con Yenilú y Dileidi hasta que Matilde les preguntas a todos que pasa, y saca la conclusión de que la única que está diciendo la verdad allí en ese momento es Yenilú porque no dio muchas explicaciones. Egleé le cuenta a Marco Aurelio por lo que atraviesa con Cristinita y este le aconseja que se lo comunique a Rómulo que es su padre. Egleé lo hace y Rómulo no lo puede creer. A su vez Cristinita le contó todo el problema que tuvo con Egleé a Gerson y ella cree que Gerson la va apoyar y que va a dejar todo por ella, cosa que no es verdad. María José conversa con Doroteo acerca del documento que vio. Y Aristigueta hace lo mismo con la Nena y tanto Doroteo como la Nena llegan a la conclusión que lo mejor es olvidar eso y pasar la página.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 85: Armando Malave es desenmascarado y reclamado
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo va a reunirse con Doris y Walter para agradecer que lo pusieron en libertad. En ese momento Doris le dice a Luis Guillermo que Armando Malavé fue la persona que dio ordenes a Braulio para quemar la Disquera. Armando Malavé está en el apartamento viendo la televisión, y en ese momento dan las noticias de que Braulio Paredes se inculpó y que el que lo mandó fue Armando Malavé. Berta reclama a Mujiquita porque ella no quiere que en negocio hayan muchachitas. Mujiquita le dice que es Reina la encargada de eso. Berta llama a Berta y le reclama. Berta le dice que esa muchacha Indira tiene 20 años. Berta le dice que quiere hablar con ella.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo se disculpa con Irene por haberla besado, Irene le dice que se olvide de lo sucedido. Julio lleva de paseo a Maria Lucia, al final del paseo se dan un beso pero los descubre Trinidad, quien se pone como loca y le pega a Maria Lucia. Luego la encierra en su casa prohibiéndole volver a ver a ese chico. Carlos va a visitar a Virginia a la cárcel para mantener una charla respecto a Irene y su objetivo en la empresa Ferrándiz. Maribel termina confesándole a Alejandra en donde se encontraba Leonardo. Alejandra furiosa pide al helicóptero de la empresa que la lleven hasta el lugar donde Leonardo se encontraba. Juan Pablo le pide a Maribel que lo acompañe a un evento, ella acepta pero no se dio cuenta que esa misma noche tenía la cena con Tony.

programme.title: Episodio 97: Salvador: Pr ncipe Azul y el Secuestro.
programme.desc: Salvador salva a la Princesa Caroline de ser secuestrada. Ella est muy agradecida con Salvador y le dice que es un pr ncipe azul.Josefina le dice a Fernando que si el Latin Lovers da dividendos quiere entrar de nuevo al negocio. Sin embargo le advierte a Fernando que si es novio de Clara no puede hacer parte de Latin Lovers.Lula le da una cachetada a Ramiro por el beso que le dio, le dice que no quiere ser la segunda. - Socorro est muy celosa porque Salvador rescat a la Princesa Caroline.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 97: El Testamento, la Verdad y la Maldad
programme.desc: Aurora le dice a Gabriel que su tío Braulio tiene el testamento de Laura. Marisela y Tomás se conocen en la clínica. Gabriel es atracada por Mandinga y Daniel la defiende. Gabriel conversa con el padre Juan acerca del testamento. Alfonso no es bien recibido por Flavia pro él va a conversar con Isadora de su divorcio con Gabriel. Isadora es descubierta por Alfonso tratando de acomodar el cuadro de Laura que le cayó encima al tramar su maldad en contra de Marisela. Reynaldo interroga a Jenniffer sobre su supuesta violación. Cuando Gavilán le cuenta a Ricardo que vio a Gabriela con Giancarlos, ella llega a la casa. Abril busca a Marisela en la clínica.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra le roba un beso a Leonardo, Irene los ve y se pone muy triste. Leonardo le pide a Alejandra que se retire de su vida. Leo y su amigo se encentran con el negociante quien resulta ser Rodrigo, les propone participar de un negocio que a ellos no les convence del todo pero terminan aceptando. Para poder ser parte del negocio necesitan invertir y buscan maneras de conseguir dinero. Maria Lucia encuentra a su mamá desmayada en el comedor, desesperada comienza a pedir auxilio pero no podía salir de la casa porque no encontraba las llaves que Trinidad le había quitado. Aparecen Zulay y Sandra para ayudarla a salir del apuro. Finalmente Trinidad despierta y puede ser asistida por los médicos, los cuales le mandan reposo absoluto.

programme.title: Episodio 98: Socorro acepta el pasado de Salvador
programme.desc: Caroline le dice a Socorro que sabe todo el pasado de Salvador y as lo acepta y le gusta. Josefina le pide excusas a la prensa y a la Princesa por la actitud de Coc. Socorro le reitera a su madre que Salvador es el amor de su vida. M s tarde Coc le cuenta a Josefina que pasar unos d as sola en la estancia de Agustina. Josefina no est de acuerdo.Charo rechaza hacer el amor con Manuel fingiendo dolor de cabeza. Manuel le recuerda a Charo que desde que est n juntos no ha tenido otra crisis, a lo que ella responde que s le hace bien. Al otro d a Charo le pide a Fernando que no le mande m s mensajes y que se limite a ser su amante, ya que Manuel le brinda estabilidad.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 98: Abril Descubre la Verdad, Gabriel Recuerda
programme.desc: Yolanda se presenta a Marisela diciéndole que es su ex. Braulio logra mentirle a Gabriel sobre el cheque. Tomás le explica Abril sobre la noche de la graduación. Reynaldo le exige a Raúl destituir a Diego de la clínica. Yolanda conversa con Celine mientras Marisela s prefiere retirarse. Daniel le quiere contar a su padre lo ocurrido y matar a Gabriel, Ricardo y Gavilán momentáneamente le impiden la salida, Daniel y Gabriela discuten por sus padres. Gabriel mientras conversa con Braulio se acuerda del fraude en la clínica. Jesús amenaza a la secretaria de Alfonso, ella se defiende. Abril se da cuenta de que no fue Reynaldo quien la violó aquella noche.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 141: Amores no correspondidos y secretos revelados.
programme.desc: Doroteo se confiesa ante la resentida Maria José al no poder apartar de su mente el recuerdo de Maria Antonia, Maria José utiliza una nueva táctica para lograr conquistar en definitiva el interés de Doroteo la cual consiste en ofrecerse como la mujer capaz de hacerlo olvidar, entre tanto Paco hace su parte al tratar de convencer a su ex esposa que vuelva a su lado y olvide de una vez a Doroteo, Maria Antonia le pone limites al padre de Tatiana al mostrarse mas que renuente a hacerle caso a su intento de reconquistarla. Gracias a la advertencia de Egleé debido al comportamiento infantil e inmaduro de Cristina Rómulo se apresura a hacerse presente en la casa de su antigua pareja para tratar de hablar con su hija, adelantándose a los chismes de Cristina Rómulo se muestra informado de la relación amorosa y clandestina que mantiene Egleé con Santiago para después ponerle un alto al disparate de su hija de querer manipular a Egleé con la idea de una fuga con Gerson. Pascuita conversa con Egleé y al no verle futuro a su relación con Santiago le aconseja que lo deje para así no pasar un mal rato cuando la información llegue a oídos de su hijo Luís Fernando, Matilde por su parte asesora a Egleé para que esta se decida a afrontar su realidad y hacer publica ante todos su relación Matilde y Pascuita llegan a coincidir solo en un punto al sugerirle a Egleé que visite a el brujo Ángel. Egleé visita a Ángel al buscar en el la ayuda para aclarar sus ideas y buscar una solución a su situación debido a su relación con Santiago. Con mas dudas que respuestas después de haber visto a Ángel Egleé regresa a la oficina para encontrarse con la sorpresa de escuchar mencionar nuevamente a Ángel pero esta vez de la boca de Betzaida quien por defender a su guía musical discute con Rómulo, Egleé llega a l conclusión d que entre Ángel y Betzaida existe una relación para perjuicio de su ex esposo Rómulo. Durante su luna de miel a pesar de los motivos que los obligaron a estar juntos Mª Gracia y Luís Fernando se muestran aburridos el uno del otro. A su regreso a la ciudad de caracas Luís Fernando es recibido por su Cristina y sus amigas situación que provoca el comentario irónico de Mª Gracia al compararlo con una estrella de Rock asediado por sus fans. Al hacer un resumen sobre su luna de miel Mª Gracia aprovecha de lucirse ante sus antiguas rivales al hacerles creer que estadía en el hotel estuvo plagada de romance y diversión, Luís Fernando utiliza una excusa para ir en busca de Dileidi. Entre tanto en la oficina Dileidi conversa con Yenilú al hacer conjeturas sobre la llegada de Luís Fernando, Dileidi se deja sorprender al saber a Luís Fernando de regreso en la oficina tras su reciente llegada de su luna de miel. A su reencuentro Luís Fernando y Dileidi intentan disimular su añoranza del uno por el otro. Cristina capta de inmediato las picaras intenciones de Tatiana después de escuchar con interés el relato de Felicita acerca de su salida con Aureliano, Egleé conversa brevemente con Gladys advirtiéndola así lo que acontece con la locura emprendida por Gerson y Cristina. Gerson conversa con Aureliano informándolo así de la verdadera situación que se le presento con Cristina al estar de picaflor quedando a su vez sorprendido con las intenciones de la muchacha al presionarlo para irse a vivir a su lado a pesar de saberlo con esposa e hijo, Tatiana se adelanta a la llegada de Felicita intentando así apoderarse del interés de Aureliano. Al tratar de hacer una simple transacción bancaria Mª Antonia se ve sometida a los rigores de la vida de la mujer común debiendo dejar su orgullo a un lado para beneficiarse con la ayuda que le brinda Paco quien contando con influencia dentro de la institución suma puntos a su favor ante su ex esposa. Por su parte Mª José logra ganarse la atención de Doroteo al informarlo sobre sus gestiones entre sus amigas para conseguirle mas trabajo y así saldar su propia cuenta además de servirle de compañía. Maria José se deja sorprender por un instante con el ordinarismo de Doroteo para después tratar de seducirlo con sus insinuantes palabras. Paco insiste en tratar de comprar el amor de Mª Antonia haciéndole múltiples ofrecimientos y ayuda económica mientras solo recibe su rechazo. Tras caer en la trampa de Tatiana Aureliano disfruta del momento en compañía de la muchacha y de lo que esta dispone para su conversación, al ir con la intención de preguntar por Aureliano, Felicita se deja invadir por la indignación al encontrar en la casa de Tatiana a su novio. Dileidi mitiga su ansiedad con la comida al no poder soportar el regreso de Luís Fernando ya casado, entre tanto Luís Fernando desahoga su frustración confesándose ante Santiago al sentirse atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor. Luís Fernando y Dileidi se encuentran a solas por un momento para después ser interrumpidos por los directivos de la empresa quienes llegan para su reunión, reunión que se convierte en una especie de juerga inquisitoria al todos insistir en preguntarle a Luís Fernando lo acontecido durante su luna de miel con Mª Gracia, Luís Fernando se encarga de mantener las apariencias acerca de su matrimonio al exigir respeto hacia Dileidi al ser esta la única mujer presente en la conversación. Tras ser sorprendido en compañía de Tatiana y en la casa de esta Aureliano se vale de mil excusas para convencer a Felicita de su interés por ella a pesar de su baja autoestima e insistir en tacharse así misma de gorda. Gladys al sentirse al tanto de la supuesta relación mantenida por su hijo Gerson y Cristina se enfrenta a la muchacha mostrándole firmemente su oposición y aclararle ciertos puntos que le impiden rotundamente continuar con la locura de insistir en una relación con su hijo al recordarle que este tiene mujer e hijo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

Luego, antes de ir a la oficina, Agustina le recuerda que esa noche será la celebración por los cincos años de la muerte de su ex esposa. Leo le confiesa a su amigo Jorge que no quiere comprometerse de ninguna manera con Oriana. Ella los escucha hablar y le deja en claro a Leo que no quiere nada más con él.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena se encuentra indignada por la presencia de Virginia en la compañía, y le aclara a todos que quiere que respeten su decisión. Sin embargo, tanto Carlos Ernesto como Leonardo no aceptan esto, y pretenden buscar una manera de incluir a Virginia en la familia. Ricardo quiere recuperar a Oriana, y para volver a hacerlo, ella le propone que conquiste a María Lucía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra encierra a Irene en el baño de mujeres de la empresa Laboratorios Ferrándiz. Después de una confusa escena llena de gritos, Leonardo se ve obligado a elegir entre la versión de Irene y la de Alejandra, quien asegura que Irene la atacó. Rodrigo le pide a Lucía unos documentos de Virginia y la chantajea con evitar que Virginia consiga trabajo y vuelva a la cárcel.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego de la pelea en el baño con Alejandra, Irene decide regresar a su casa sin decirle a Leonardo. Ahí, su hermana Lucía le confiesa que Rodrigo Basáñez la ha estado amenazando. Agustina recibe una extraña llamada telefónica de alguien que decía ser su difunta hermana, lo cual la angustia muchísimo, ya que ese día iba a preparar una cena especial en honor a ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene insiste en que Leonardo debe creer en su inocencia sin necesidad de pruebas. Él va a casa de su madre a buscarla, pero, tras una charla larga, ella decide tomarse un tiempo para que ambos reflexionen. Leonardo no está presente la noche de la ceremonia en memoria de Rebeca, porque fue con Anzola a buscar a Irene. Agustina se enfurece y promete revelar un secreto terrible a la familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene decide no regresar con Leonardo por el momento. Virginia y Maribel, al verla tan triste, organizan un picnic familiar, con la ayuda de Felipe, quien no puede ocultar lo que siente por Irene. Virginia se entera de que Alejandra Altamirano y Rodrigo Basañez son amantes. Leonardo está terriblemente angustiado y le pide a Trinidad que hable con Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra visita la casa de Leonardo, donde se encuentra él e Irene. Ella culpa a Irene por su accidente, pero Leonardo se rehúsa terminantemente a tratar ese tema fuera de la oficina. Irene se va cuando se entera que su madre ya había abandonado la casa. Leonardo trata de retenerla en vano, y luego se encierra en su habitación, dejando a Alejandra esperando en la sala.
En el 2044, los supervivientes a la mutación de una bacteria viven en refugios distantes para no contagiarse.

programme.title: A Royal Surprise
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley, Mandla, la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende al descubrir que él es un príncipe. La noticia pone en peligro la confianza de Riley en Mandla.

programme.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
programme.desc: Una reconocida chef de televisión de Los Ángeles recibe la propuesta de conducir un nuevo programa que la llevará por distintas ciudades de Europa. Sin embargo, le preocupa dejar a su hija adolescente, quien aún no ha superado la nostalgia por su antigua vida en San Antonio.

programme.title: 5 Bodas
programme.desc: Una periodista que escribe una historia sobre bodas en Punjabi se enamora de su oficial de enlace, quien intenta mantener su historia censurada en medio de un colorido mosaico de bailarines transgénero y choques culturales.

programme.title: Top 10: Secretos y misterios
programme.desc: El programa de hoy examina las misteriosas criaturas que pueden vivir en la Tierra.

programme.title: Mi Billionario Secreto
programme.desc: Para satisfacer el deseo de su padre, un apuesto y poderoso multimillonario viaja solo, sin dinero y sin usar su nombre real a la ciudad de Nueva York. Cuando el ex playboy conoce a un agente inmobiliario atractivo y con los pies en la tierra, la razón detrás del deseo de su padre se vuelve evidente y ambos descubrirán que el amor verdadero es algo que el dinero no puede comprar.

programme.title: The Inquisition Of Camilo Sanz
programme.desc: Después de una vida en NYC con documentos falsos, Camilo recibe una nota de deportación.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad llega junto a Zulay, Sandra y sus amigos, para ver que su casa ha sido desordenada completamente. Nada de valor se encontraba allí, por lo que sospechan que ha sido para buscar los documentos de Virginia. María Lucía escucha a Trinidad y a Virginia hablando sobre su secreto, y las confronta para saberlo, pero ellas se niegan completamente.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene llega a la casa de Leonardo para asistir a Rebeca por la fiebre que está sufriendo. Agustina se pone en su camino y le prohíbe la entrada, argumentando que Leonardo dijo explícitamente que no la dejara pasar nadie a Irene. Ella termina subiendo con el permiso de la señora Jimena. A Rebeca se le cura la fiebre por la alegría que le causa la presencia de Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia le confirma a su madre, Trinidad, de que va a trabajar en Ferrándiz. Trinidad no lo acepta de ninguna manera. Rebeca se cura gracias a la asistencia de Irene, que, a su vez se reconcilia con Leonardo. La señora Jimena se entera por su hijo que Virginia va a trabajar en la empresa, reniega de eso y va a solicitar un impedimento legal para que ella no se pueda acercar a su familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo tiene un cruce con Irene tras aparecer en la empresa y poner nerviosa a Virginia quien acaba de ser contratada como secretaria de Carlos Ernesto. Toni trata de explicarle a María Lucía su situación con Oriana, quien aparece en las oficinas para hablar con Leonardo, pero sin éxito ella decide terminar la relación. Agustina obliga a Rebeca a quedarse en casa finalizando sus tareas.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucia busca consuelo en Sandra por el fin de su relación con Leo. Al volver a su hogar, descubre una peor noticia mientras Zulay y Trinidad discuten, la de no ser hija biológica de su madre. Llena de incertidumbre y furia se va de su casa decidida a alejarse de todos, con Ricardo que aparece en el momento justo para ayudarla. Leo quiere resarcirse por la discusión previa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía se va furiosa de la casa de Trinidad al enterarse que no es su verdadera madre. Huye con Ricardo a una casa alejada. Oriana quiere que Ricardo tome fotos de María Lucía con él. Jimena intenta ponerle una caución legal a Virginia para mantenerla alejada de los miembros de la familia Ferrándiz y de las empresas. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto deciden brindarle su apoyo.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | Hot and Cold Crystals
programme.desc: 300 feet from a pocket of molten magma is a chamber filled with giant blue and pink crystals as 60 feet long!

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here’s the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here’s the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world’s most deadly virus. So here’s the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Rancho Esperanza
programme.desc: Una joven lo tiene todo: un hermoso rancho, un caballo llamado Faith y el amor de su familia. Pero tras la muerte de su padre, un militar, ella y su madre corren el riesgo de perder también el rancho familiar. Con un poco de ayuda de sus amigos y de su majestuoso caballo blanco, urden un plan para reunir el dinero suficiente para salvar el rancho mientras aprenden a no perder nunca la esperanza, a pesar de todo.

programme.title: Amor Desencadenado
programme.desc: Sarah se entera de que su perro ha sido adoptado. Mientras ella y el nuevo dueño, Mike, luchan por la custodia, la pareja se enamora. Pero Mike tiene un secreto y Sarah se aleja. ¿Podrá prevalecer el amor verdadero?

programme.title: Amor Idéntico
programme.desc: Después de ser dejada en el altar, la Dra. Charlotte Hudson necesita escapar de la vida en su hogar. Ella se inscribe como voluntaria en una clínica de salud en un país tropical. Pero sus planes de escapar se frustran cuando se encuentra con el hermano gemelo de su ex prometido, Seth (un dentista), que también trabaja como voluntario en la clínica. Mientras pasan tiempo juntos, Seth se enamora de Charlotte, pero ella lucha por dejar de ver a su prometido cada vez que mira a Seth. El romance isleño la ayudará a liberarse del pasado y amar a Seth por quien es.

programme.title: La Receta Del Amor
programme.desc: Una ocupada cirujana regresa a casa para celebrar que su padre se ha convertido en alcalde. Pero tras un encuentro fortuito con el único médico del pueblo -y el soltero más codiciado-, es testigo de una verdadera compasión que podría ser la receta que este médico necesita.

programme.title: Cenicienta en el Caribe
programme.desc: Ashlyn Vanderbilt viaja con su madrastra Miriam y su prometido Bruce para su boda de destino. Aunque Ashlyn encuentra amistad y amor con el hijo de Bruce, Noah, lucha por tener su felices para siempre cuando descubre que su familia adoptiva planea arruinar a Bruce.

programme.title: Retiro Al Paraíso
programme.desc: Ellie atiende al lastimado y cascarrabias Jordan mientras se recupera de una lesión en el hombro. Aunque lucha por aprender a usar su brazo nuevamente, su actitud hace que Ellie quiera dejarlo en su miseria. Pero a medida que se conocen más, Jordan comienza a ver que Ellie es exactamente a quien quiere en su vida, y espera que Ellie sienta lo mismo.

programme.title: Pasaporte Al Amor
programme.desc: Nicole, una bloguera de viajes de éxito, conoce a Kade, representante de marketing de una editorial de viajes, y entablan una relación mientras exploran una isla.
